001package org.clafer.ast;
002
003import java.io.Serializable;
004
005/**
006 * Low and high cardinality. Immutable.
007 *
008 * @author jimmy
009 */
010public class Card implements Serializable {
011
012    private static final long serialVersionUID = 1;
013    private static final int UNBOUNDED_HIGH = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
014    private final int low;
015    private final int high;
016
017    /**
018     * Construct an unbounded cardinality.
019     */
020    public Card() {
021        this(0, UNBOUNDED_HIGH);
022    }
023
024    /**
025     * Construct a cardinality bounded from below, unbounded above.
026     *
027     * @param low the low cardinality
028     */
029    public Card(int low) {
030        this(low, UNBOUNDED_HIGH);
031    }
032
033    /**
034     * Construct a cardinality bounded from below and above.
035     *
036     * @param low the low cardinality
037     * @param high the high cardinality
038     */
039    public Card(int low, int high) {
040        if (low < 0) {
041            throw new IllegalArgumentException("low(" + low + ") < 0");
042        }
043        if (high < low) {
044            throw new IllegalArgumentException("high(" + high + ") > low(" + low + ")");
045        }
046        this.low = low;
047        this.high = high;
048    }
049
050    /**
051     * Detects if this cardinality is so restrictive that only one possible
052     * value is allowed.
053     *
054     * @return {@code true} if and only if low and high cardinality is the same,
055     * {@code false} otherwise
056     */
057    public boolean isExact() {
058        return low == high;
059    }
060
061    /**
062     * Detects if this cardinality is either bounded below and/or above.
063     *
064     * @return {@code true} if and only if this cardinality is not unbounded,
065     * {@code false} otherwise
066     */
067    public boolean isBounded() {
068        return hasLow() || hasHigh();
069    }
070
071    /**
072     * Detects if this cardinality is bounded below.
073     *
074     * @return {@code true} if and only if this cardinality is bounded below,
075     * {@code false} otherwise
076     */
077    public boolean hasLow() {
078        return low != 0;
079    }
080
081    /**
082     * Returns the low cardinality or 0 if unbounded from below.
083     *
084     * @return the low cardinality
085     */
086    public int getLow() {
087        return low;
088    }
089
090    /**
091     * Detects if this cardinality is bounded above.
092     *
093     * @return {@code true} if and only if this cardinality is bounded above,
094     * {@code false} otherwise
095     */
096    public boolean hasHigh() {
097        return high != UNBOUNDED_HIGH;
098    }
099
100    /**
101     * Returns the high cardinality or Integer.MAX_VALUE if unbounded form
102     * above.
103     *
104     * @return the high cardinality
105     */
106    public int getHigh() {
107        return high;
108    }
109
110    /**
111     * Add two cardinalities together.
112     *
113     * @param addend the other cardinality
114     * @return the sum of this and the other cardinality
115     */
116    public Card add(Card addend) {
117        if (hasHigh() && addend.hasHigh()) {
118            return new Card(low + addend.low, high + addend.high);
119        }
120        return new Card(low + addend.low);
121    }
122
123    /**
124     * Multiply two cardinalities together.
125     *
126     * @param factor the other cardinality
127     * @return the product of this and the other cardinality
128     */
129    public Card mult(Card factor) {
130        if (hasHigh() && factor.hasHigh()) {
131            return new Card(low * factor.low, high * factor.high);
132        }
133        return new Card(low * factor.low);
134    }
135
136    @Override
137    public boolean equals(Object obj) {
138        if (obj instanceof Card) {
139            Card other = (Card) obj;
140            return low == other.low && high == other.high;
141        }
142        return false;
143    }
144
145    @Override
146    public int hashCode() {
147        return low ^ high;
148    }
149
150    @Override
151    public String toString() {
152        if (!hasHigh()) {
153            return hasLow() ? low + "..*" : "*";
154        }
155        return isExact() ? Integer.toString(low) : low + ".." + high;
156    }
157}
